lines.text: [warm] Your competitors already found the ads that work. Here's how to see them.
This is Competitor Ads. A live wall of real ads running in your industry right now.
Keep scrolling. There are over a hundred thousand live ads in here — pulled from Google and Meta, and refreshed every day.
Slice it any way you like. One industry. [curious] One platform. Only image ads — or only the plain text ones from search.
But the real power is tracking specific competitors. Open the tracked tab — Ryze already found the brands running ads in your space.
Pick the ones you care about, and track them.
From now on, their ads live here. Every campaign they launch, every creative they test — synced automatically.
Click a brand to see just their playbook.

And here's the trick most people miss. Open any ad and look at one number — how long it's been running. [curious] Ninety one days. Nobody pays for a losing ad for three months. If it's still running, it's making money.
So don't just admire it. Hit generate similar — and the agent drafts your own version of that proven ad, in your brand's style, with your product.
One last thing. Turn on alerts for a competitor. Enable — and the day they launch something new, you get an email.
So — watch the whole market, track the brands that matter, and turn their winning ads into yours. [smiling] They do the testing. You take the results.
